summary.text: Dan Moul is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 91, which he has represented since December 2006, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
His professional experience includes sales and supervision for Utz Quality Foods and work as a real estate renovator.

paragraphs.text: Moul earned a bachelor's degree in finance from York College in 1980.
In the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions Moul chaired the House Agriculture & Rural Affairs Committee, and in 2019-2020 he chaired the House Local Government Committee.
